Subject: NorthBridge renewal: marketplace cutover proposal & next steps

Hi Julia --

Thanks again for the time last week. As NorthBridge approaches your renewal on 11/15, we wanted to propose a pragmatic cutover plan to move your seat/license billing from our direct invoicing to AWS Marketplace. The goals are: simplify procurement, enable consolidated billing, and preserve the current entitlements and seat counts without service interruptions.

I've attached a one-page transition worksheet that captures the current billing profile and suggested timing. High-level proposal:
- Renewal date: 2026-11-15 stays as the anchor
- Marketplace subscription effective: 2026-12-01 (one billing cycle after renewal) to avoid mid-cycle proration
- Short runway: 30-day cutover sprint (procurement, entitlement mapping, SSO & license sync, DocuSign)
- Commercial ask: move to marketplace list pricing with a one-time conversion credit to offset first-months' double-billing risk

Would you be able to share who on your procurement/finance side owns the Marketplace onboarding? Also: any constraints around PO vs marketplace listing, or legal redlines we should be aware of up front?

If that timeline looks reasonable I can draft a mutual action plan and loop in Ben and our marketplace ops to align on the DocuSign and entitlement mapping.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: marketplace-transition-worksheet.xlsx

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the clear proposal. A few quick items from procurement/finance:
- We need an MRR-to-marketplace equivalence sheet so we can confirm there isn't an over/under‑charge during the first 2 invoices
- SSO / SCIM provisioning must be validated before cutover — our identity team will need to test in a staging tenant
- Entitlements: current seat allocation comes from our enterprise SAML group; we want a zero-downtime mapping
- Legal: marketplace listings generally work for us, but our legal team will want to review the standard marketplace terms vs. the current direct-contract SOW (specifically IP and data residency clauses)

I've looped in contracts+procurement who will pick this up formally. They may request your pricing worksheet and any standard marketplace order forms you have.

Julia Hanson
VP, Finance & Operations
NorthBridge Analytics
